headline: The next backend step is a thin source packet service.
copy: VedaPath should first prove source lookup, no-source behavior, and demo logging with local deterministic code before opening any real service.

postures.title: Source packet service
postures.copy: Return reviewed source candidates, no-source results, confidence, and boundary fields from local fixtures.

postures.title: Live answer generation
postures.copy: No model-generated answer should run until source packets and no-source tests are stable.

postures.title: Production storage
postures.copy: No user reflections, demo data, or reviewer records leave the browser or local files in this batch.

postures.title: Public launch
postures.copy: Rights, reviewer operations, identity, privacy, support, and security remain unresolved.

flow.title: Decide slice
flow.copy: Build only Source API stub, retrieval fixture CLI, demo ledger contract, and readiness control.

flow.title: Prove fixtures
flow.copy: Use deterministic questions to test source found, no-source, hold, and review paths.

flow.title: Keep locks visible
flow.copy: Every page states what is not enabled.

flow.title: Review next
flow.copy: Founder decides whether to create a real backend repo or keep improving fixtures.

decisions.label: Local Source API stub
decisions.reason: Useful for validating response shape without private data or network dependency.

decisions.label: Retrieval fixture CLI
decisions.reason: Lets us run repeatable tests before choosing infrastructure.

decisions.label: Private demo ledger schema
decisions.reason: Defines events and consent posture without storing production user data.

decisions.label: Live AI answers
decisions.reason: Evidence, rights, evaluation, and review gates must pass first.

decisions.label: Public launch
decisions.reason: Launch remains closed until source, rights, reviewer, privacy, and support systems are real.

locks.title: Source lock
locks.copy: Backend responses must start as source packets, not eloquent answer text.

locks.title: No-source lock
locks.copy: A refusal path is a successful result, not an error.

locks.title: Privacy lock
locks.copy: Demo and practice memories remain browser-local until explicit consent and deletion exist.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: The backend cannot present VedaPath as guru, therapist, clinician, or ritual authority.

packet:
Backend Prototype Decision Gate v4.6.6
Decision: build a local Source API stub, retrieval fixture CLI, and private demo ledger shape.
Allowed: deterministic source packet tests.
Blocked: live AI answers, production storage, public launch, payments, sensitive intake.
Next: implement Source API stub.
